# Source => result or error diagnostic (the host prints source on both paths).
1; 2 => 2
{ 1; 2 } => 2
1 2 => error:expected semicolon
{ 1 2 } => error:expected semicolon
let x = 2; x = 3 4 => error:expected semicolon
while 0 { 1 } 7 => error:expected semicolon
while 0 { 1 }; !0 => 1
while 0 { 1 } !0 => error:expected semicolon
while 0 { 1 }; -2 => -2
while 0 { 1 } -2 => error:expected semicolon
1 -2 => -1
while 0 { 1 }; [2][0] => 2
while 0 { 1 } [2][0] => error:expected semicolon
while 0 { 1 } @ => error:trailing input
1 (2) => error:expected semicolon
1 { 2 } => error:expected semicolon
1 @ 2 => error:trailing input
